requests.reply: {"translations": ["A rainy harbor town. A police car is parked in front of an old clock shop.", "Senpai Kaoru, the scene is here. The lock was still engaged."]}
{"translations": ["Hmm. Only one pocket watch was stolen, then?"]}
{"translations": ["The shopkeeper, old Takanashi, sits in his chair, staring at the floor."]}
{"translations": ["You've arrived, detectives. I'll say this up front: don't touch anything without permission.", "Yes, Inspector. I'll be careful."]}
{"translations": ["Don't call me Inspector. Akira is fine. Especially in front of Ms. Takanashi."]}
{"translations": ["Understood, Akira-san"]}
{"translations": ["The elderly Takanashi slowly raised his head."]}
{"translations": ["Akira folded his umbrella and wiped up the drops of water from the floor.", "Akira-san, please place your umbrella over here."]}
{"translations": ["Hikaru, who did you ask to look after the office while you're away?"]}
{"translations": ["This is Nagi. I'm still just an eighteen-year-old girl, but I'm quite dependable. Please rest assured, Akira-san."]}
{"translations": ["That's a relief. They handle phone duties and paperwork too."]}
{"translations": ["Let's save the small talk for later. We're starting the questioning first.", "Akira-san, may I hear from Takanashi-san first?"]}
{"translations": ["In a trembling voice, the old man answered that he had closed the shop at nine o'clock last night."]}
{"translations": ["My grandfather has been polishing only that clock for many years."]}
{"translations": ["Apparently Yuki hasn't been able to sleep since last night. Her fingertips have been trembling the whole time."]}
{"translations": ["Hikaru, how do you read these footprints?", "Akira-san, these aren't the culprit's. The shoes are too big."]}
{"translations": ["Hikaru's powers of observation are sharp. He's still a rookie, but he doesn't lose to anyone."]}
{"translations": ["Kaoru took off her glasses and slowly pressed the bridge of her nose."]}
{"translations": ["That watch is also a keepsake from my mother ▼", "Nagi rushed in, clutching a wet umbrella."]}
{"translations": ["Out of breath, she relayed the phone message."]}
{"translations": ["Akira-san, the forensic results are in. I'll share them with the senior officer right away."]}
{"translations": ["Let me hear it. ...Oh? The culprit is inside the shop, then."]}
{"translations":["Old Man Takanashi's hand trembled slightly.","Outside the window, the rain grew especially heavy."]}

translations.1: A rainy harbor town. A police car is parked in front of an old clock shop.

translations.14: That's a relief. They handle phone duties and paperwork too.
translations.15: Let's save the small talk for later. We're starting the questioning first.
translations.16: Akira-san, may I hear from Takanashi-san first?
translations.17: In a trembling voice, the old man answered that he had closed the shop at nine o'clock last night.
translations.18: My grandfather has been polishing only that clock for many years.
translations.19: Apparently Yuki hasn't been able to sleep since last night. Her fingertips have been trembling the whole time.
translations.2: Senpai Kaoru, the scene is here. The lock was still engaged.
translations.20: Hikaru, how do you read these footprints?
translations.21: Akira-san, these aren't the culprit's. The shoes are too big.
translations.22: Hikaru's powers of observation are sharp. He's still a rookie, but he doesn't lose to anyone.
translations.23: Kaoru took off her glasses and slowly pressed the bridge of her nose.
translations.24: That watch is also a keepsake from my mother ▼
translations.25: Nagi rushed in, clutching a wet umbrella.
translations.26: Out of breath, she relayed the phone message.
translations.27: Akira-san, the forensic results are in. I'll share them with the senior officer right away.
translations.28: Let me hear it. ...Oh? The culprit is inside the shop, then.
translations.29: Old Man Takanashi's hand trembled slightly.
